items.title: First Solar (FSLR) Opens South Carolina Plant With New Jobs In Focus
items.summary: First Solar (NasdaqGS:FSLR) has opened a new solar manufacturing facility in Gaffney, South Carolina, expanding its U.S. footprint. The Gaffney plant is expected to support additional U.S. clean energy manufacturing capacity alongside new jobs in the region. The South Carolina inauguration marks another operational milestone for First Solar's domestic production network.
